## iPad sidebar, like the Apple TV app

- Showing or hiding the sidebar now reshapes Home and the game page smoothly, in step with the sidebar: the picture shrinks or grows whole (16:9, never cropped) and the logo, text, buttons and rows slide over with it.
- The sidebar's glass takes the colours of the art, and of the trailer as it plays.
- The carousel keeps playing its trailer through the change.

## Carousel

- Swiping between games follows your finger, with a little resistance at the first and last game.
